description: This file defines an update handler for organization settings and metadata, including functions for handling banners, permissions, and updating organization details in a TRPC-based API.

methods.name: getBannerUrl
methods.description: Processes banner image input, resizes and uploads if valid base64 image, or returns null/undefined based on input.

methods.name: updateOrganizationSettings
methods.description: Updates organization settings and handles locking or deleting event types based on input options.

methods.name: updateHandler
methods.description: Main function to handle organization update requests, including permission checks, slug validation, metadata merging, and transactionally updating organization data.
